description: 凌乱金发搭配头戴护目镜，颊侧蓝色纹样保留年轻探险者神态。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ezreal is a blond young adult explorer with blue eyes, tousled hair, round goggles on his head, and recognizable blue cheek markings. Preserve his agile human proportions and blue-brown travel outfit through a fully covering jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and sturdy boots. His ornate golden magical gauntlet remains attached to one forearm but quiet and unlit, without a projectile or aimed gesture.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sunlit blond, cobalt, leather brown, pale sandstone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
